quotes.text: There are far too many “machines for turning commons into tragedies” running amok for there to be any significant creation of commons in the future. The machines are in a race to the bottom: they cannot prevent themselves from harvesting too early and too aggressively for any commons that does somehow get created anyway to survive.
quotes.author: fwlr
quotes.source: Hacker News — Humans will never again create a project like Wikipedia
quotes.extraction_note: “Machines for turning commons into tragedies” is a genuinely sharp, memorable phrase; trimmed the bulleted reasoning into one clean second sentence.
